description: This file defines a worker for handling batch database migrations within a clustered Mattermost environment, including cluster synchronization checks, job processing, and completion marking.

classes.name: BatchMigrationWorker
classes.description: A worker struct responsible for executing batch database migrations, ensuring cluster synchronization, and marking completion.

classes.name: BatchMigrationWorkerAppIFace
classes.description: An interface providing method to get cluster status for the migration worker.

methods.name: MakeBatchMigrationWorker
methods.description: Factory function to create a new BatchMigrationWorker with specified parameters.

methods.name: doBatch
methods.description: Performs a migration batch, checks cluster sync, handles errors, and updates job data.

methods.name: checkIsClusterInSync
methods.description: Checks if all nodes in the cluster are running the same schema version.

methods.name: markAsComplete
methods.description: Marks the migration as complete in the system store to prevent reruns.
